## Reference

<!-- cli-ref:start (generated by `nlink-lab docs-gen`; do not edit) -->

```text
Generate shell completions.

Static completions for the given shell. For completions that know deployed lab, node and rule names, source the dynamic form instead: bash `source <(COMPLETE=bash nlink-lab)`, zsh `source <(COMPLETE=zsh nlink-lab)`, fish `COMPLETE=fish nlink-lab | source`.

Usage: nlink-lab completions <SHELL>

Arguments:
  <SHELL>
          Shell to generate completions for
          
          [possible values: bash, elvish, fish, powershell, zsh]

Options:
  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')
```

<!-- cli-ref:end -->
